title: Route GET /export/daw-set/{scoreId} on apricity serve, zipped, with located errors
description:
## Intent

The export route on the local server.

## Steps

- Specs first: the scenarios of "apricity serve hands out DAW sets" in `features/serve/serve.feature`, as Rust tests in `crates/apricity-cli/src/serve.rs` (its test fixture library, with generated WAVs); watch them fail.
- `GET /export/daw-set/{scoreId}`: API key like `/graphql`; load the score and its samples from the library (the loader `compile_from_library` uses); run the same export as `apricity export --daw-set` (shared code in `crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs`) into a temp folder; stream a zip (add the `zip` crate); `422` with `{problems: [...]}` carrying the CLI's located messages; `404` for an unknown score; warnings in a response header.
- `design/storage.md` §4: list the route.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli serve`; `scripts/serve-smoke.sh` still passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): apricity serve exports DAW sets`. Not breaking.
